sourceText:
Panned Veal Chop
By: Anonymous
Published: Monday, November 30, 2009 - 11:37pm

Ingredients




4 Veal chops from rib-rack - (10 - 12 oz ea) see * Note
2 cups Flour
2 cups Fine dried bread crumbs
2 Eggs beaten with
2 tablespoons Milk
2 tablespoons Butter
2 tablespoons Olive oil

Preparation

1 Using a sharp knife, butterfly each chop. Cover each chop with a large piece of plastic wrap. Using a meat mallet, pound out each chop, about 1/2-inch thick. Season the chops with Emeril's Essence. 2 In a shallow bowl, season the flour with Essence. In another shallow bowl, season the bread crumbs with Essence. Dredge the meat in the flour. Dip each veal chop in the egg wash, letting the excess drip off. Dredge each chop in the seasoned bread crumbs, coating each chop completely. 3 In a large saute pan or skillet, heat the butter and oil. When the oil is hot, pan-fry each chop for about 3 to 4 minutes on each side. Remove from the pan and drain the chop on a paper-lined plate. Season the chops with Essence. 4 This recipe yields 4 chops.
